title: Car Consignment or Direct Sale in Manila?
description: Compare a purchase offer, a buyer introduction and a consignment agreement before handing over your vehicle.
summary: Start by asking who will buy the vehicle and who will hold the keys while it is marketed. In a direct purchase, compare the written amount and payment date. For an introduction or consignment, agree who handles enquiries, viewings, custody and payment.

sections.heading: Three arrangements a seller may encounter
paragraphs: With a direct offer, an identified buyer quotes for your particular vehicle, usually subject to inspection. Ask how long the amount is valid and when you would receive the funds. With a buyer introduction, the intermediary connects the parties. Ask who negotiates, who verifies payment and whether a fee is due.

If a dealer proposes consignment, request the terms before leaving the car. Establish where it will be kept, who can move or demonstrate it, what happens if it is damaged and how you end the arrangement. Ask for a signed inventory of the keys and items handed over.

sections.heading: Compare what you would actually receive
paragraphs: Suppose one buyer offers ₱600,000 directly. A hypothetical consignment sale at ₱630,000 with an agreed ₱20,000 fee would leave ₱610,000 before any other costs. That ₱10,000 difference depends on a completed sale at the assumed price. Ask whether storage, preparation or advertising costs would change it. These figures illustrate the calculation only.

sections.heading: How the Everest example helps
paragraphs: DT Car’s We Buy Cars page marked a 2024 Everest Titanium 4x4 sold and explained that the team can introduce sellers to clients when a direct purchase price does not suit them. The post does not specify the final price or the contractual arrangement for that particular vehicle. Ask which route DT Car can offer for yours.

checklist: Identify the purchaser and who holds the car.
Write down the net amount after agreed fees.
Confirm timing, viewing arrangements and handover.

title: Selling Your Car Before Leaving the Philippines
description: Plan an appraisal and vehicle handover around your departure date, with language support from DT Car.
summary: Work backwards from the last day you can attend a viewing, confirm payment and hand over the vehicle. Tell DT Car your city, departure window, exact variant and preferred language in the first enquiry.

sections.heading: Build the sale around the date you still need the car
paragraphs: Your flight date may be later than your last practical handover date. If you need the car to move luggage, identify the earliest date you can release it. Give the team both dates so it can discuss realistic viewing times. For a tight deadline, ask when a direct offer can be confirmed after inspection.

sections.heading: Arrange access while you are still available
paragraphs: Keep both keys, available service records and vehicle documents together for the inspection. If you have an outstanding loan, ask your lender how long a settlement statement and release of documents take in your case. If another person might handle a step after your departure, have the parties verify what authority they will accept in advance.

sections.heading: Send one useful enquiry
paragraphs: Example: “I am in Pasay and can show my vehicle on Saturday. It is a [year, variant, transmission] with [mileage]. I need it until [date] and leave on [date]. Can you arrange an appraisal and confirm how payment and handover would work?” Attach current photos of the actual vehicle. Use the contact directory for Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean or English/Filipino assistance.

checklist: List two possible viewing windows.
Identify the last practical handover date.
Confirm the payment recipient and collection arrangements.

title: Green GSM Driver Application or EV Rental?
description: Choose the correct Philippine enquiry route for a taxi driver application or an EV rental for ride-hailing.
summary: Green GSM rental is paused until further notice. New registrations and deposits are on hold. If you want to apply to drive a Green GSM taxi, use the driver recruitment route. If you want to rent a vehicle for ride-hailing, request the rental terms for the vehicle you are considering. The next appointment, documents and payments depend on the route.

sections.heading: When you are applying as a driver
paragraphs: Start with the official Philippine taxi driver application. Green GSM describes a professional driving licence requirement and an assessment process. Tell the recruitment team your city and when you can attend, then obtain the current location and document list before travelling. Keep the contact or reference from that application.

sections.heading: When you are asking to rent a vehicle
paragraphs: Tell the rental team which vehicle, location and start date you are considering. Request the payment schedule, deposit treatment, charging arrangements and responsibilities during downtime. Before paying, match the programme and model named on your form with the written offer you received.

sections.heading: If you have already contacted the other team
paragraphs: Send a short correction with the type of enquiry you intended. A driver applicant could write: “I want to apply to drive a taxi. Where is the next assessment for my area?” A renter could write: “I want to rent an EV for ride-hailing. Can I see the terms and availability for my city?” Ask whether any existing reference can be used before creating a second application.

checklist: Choose recruitment or rental.
Confirm the team, vehicle or assessment location.
Keep your application reference and current terms.

references.label: Green GSM Philippine taxi driver application
Green GSM’s description of its rental programme

title: How to Budget for an EV Rental Shift
description: Calculate the cash needed for a ride-hailing shift from your own rental quotation and actual shift receipts.
summary: Green GSM rental is paused until further notice. New registrations and deposits are on hold. Start with the amount the platform actually pays you. Subtract the rental payment, any separately payable deposit instalment, charging, parking and other driver-paid costs. Compare the cash left across both busy and quiet shifts before choosing a vehicle.

sections.heading: Use a settlement statement for your starting figure
paragraphs: A passenger fare and the amount released to the driver can differ. Start from the settlement amount after platform deductions if it is available. Otherwise list gross fares and each deduction once. Keep tips and incentives on separate lines so you can also see whether the shift works without them.

sections.heading: Work one hypothetical shift
paragraphs: Imagine ₱2,400 released to a driver, a ₱1,000 rental payment, a ₱200 deposit instalment, ₱180 spent on charging and ₱100 in other costs. That leaves ₱920 in cash from the shift. If receipts fall to ₱1,700 with the same outgoings, ₱220 remains. These are invented worksheet inputs, not published programme rates or expected earnings.

Track the deposit instalment separately in your records. Its effect on cash today is clear, but whether any amount is returned or applied later depends on the agreement. Ask for those terms in writing.

sections.heading: Count payable days as well as driving days
paragraphs: For a month, multiply the contract payment by the number of days it is due. Enter driving income only on the days you expect to work. Ask about maintenance days, holidays and time off. Use actual charging receipts and the promotion stated for your specific account. Check whether your reserve covers a slow week or an unexpected day off.

checklist: Obtain the current agreement for the exact vehicle.
Count deposit cash outflows separately.
Run a quiet-shift and a missed-shift scenario.

references.label: Green GSM’s description of its rental programme

title: How to Compare EV Workshop Estimates
description: Read an EV workshop estimate line by line and agree which work can proceed before your appointment.
summary: Ask each workshop to describe the same concern and quote the same scope. Separate diagnosis, parts, labour and other charges. Agree who must approve additional work and how you will receive the revised amount.

sections.heading: Make the two estimates comparable
paragraphs: One quotation may cover only an initial diagnostic appointment while another includes the work the adviser expects will follow. Ask what the initial amount buys and whether it is credited against later work. For a reported dashboard alert, give the exact message, model and conditions when it appeared so both advisers are answering the same question.

sections.heading: Resolve uncertain items before authorising work
paragraphs: If a part is listed, ask which component is included, whether it is available and how long the estimate remains valid. If coverage under a warranty is being considered, ask who determines eligibility and what charges would apply if the claim is declined. Keep the provider’s written response with your estimate.

sections.heading: Agree a handover record
paragraphs: Confirm the name of the person who can approve changes, how to reach them and the vehicle collection arrangement. At collection, request a record of the reported concern, checks completed, parts used and any follow-up appointment. When contacting DT Car, give your city so the team can coordinate an appropriate workshop enquiry.

checklist: Compare the same diagnostic or repair scope.
Confirm who approves changes to the price.
Keep the estimate, approval and work record together.

title: Fleet Dashcam Handover Checklist
description: Prepare an acceptance sheet for a multi-vehicle dashcam installation and record exceptions before releasing vehicles.
summary: Agree what counts as a completed installation for one vehicle before starting the full batch. Match the vehicle to its assigned device, carry out the agreed functional check and record whether the operator accepted it or requested follow-up.

sections.heading: Define one completed unit
paragraphs: A fitted camera, a powered camera and a camera visible to the operator can represent three different milestones. Specify which applies to the order. For a connected camera, agree who supplies the SIM and configuration, who can access the operator platform and who can confirm a successful check. Keep account credentials out of general handover sheets.

sections.heading: Test the handover on the first vehicle
paragraphs: Select a representative vehicle with the depot team. At handover, match the vehicle identifier and device identifier, check placement against the approved reference and have the authorised operator confirm the agreed functions. Agree which photographs are needed and where the project team will retain them. Use the accepted unit as a reference for later shifts.

sections.heading: Keep exceptions visible
paragraphs: A fitted device awaiting operator activation needs its own status and owner. Record what is pending, who can resolve it, the next check date and whether the vehicle can be released under depot rules. At shift end, reconcile accepted units, units awaiting rework and vehicles that did not arrive against the planned list. This avoids billing or scheduling the same job twice.

checklist: Agree the acceptance test before the batch.
Match vehicle and device identifiers.
Assign every open exception to an owner.

title: Can a Restaurant or Hotel Host EV Charging?
description: Prepare a charging-site proposal around real guest parking, delivery movements, access hours and electrical review.
summary: DT Car’s charging partner channel invites restaurants, cafés, hotels and other commercial hosts to propose locations. Start with a map pin, the bays you can make available, the hours drivers can enter and the contact authorised to discuss the property.

sections.heading: Walk the site during its busiest hour
paragraphs: For a restaurant, sketch how a charging vehicle would enter while diners and delivery motorcycles are arriving. At a hotel, check whether the route shares a lobby drop-off, tour-van bay or service entrance. Take photos from the road and from the proposed bays. Explain any time restrictions or gate procedures a driver would encounter.

sections.heading: Describe what a driver could use during a stop
paragraphs: List the facilities that would actually be open during proposed charging hours, such as food service, toilets or a waiting area. Say whether these are public, guest-only or subject to parking charges. An amenity inside a building that closes before the parking area needs its own hours in the proposal.

sections.heading: Prepare the commercial and technical handoff
paragraphs: Identify who controls the land and the parking operation, the available lease area and the relevant commercial contact. Share existing supply information held by the property team. Flag drainage issues and service access for technical review. Ask the team which documents it needs next before commissioning any work or promising a launch date.

checklist: Show usable bays during peak traffic.
Describe entrance restrictions and amenity hours.
Name the authorised property and technical contacts.

title: How to Plan an Electric Fleet Pilot Route
description: Use one representative route and shift log to assess a Philippine electric fleet proposal before increasing the vehicle count.
summary: Start with a route that represents your normal workload. Record actual distance, time available for charging, energy purchased, completed assignments and downtime. Include the dispatch team and the person responsible for accepting the vehicle at the depot.

sections.heading: Choose a route the fleet really runs
paragraphs: A short demonstration drive answers different questions from a complete shift. Include the return journey, empty kilometres between assignments, passenger or equipment loads, and any fixed dispatch deadlines. Identify a busy-day route as a separate scenario if it differs substantially from the normal schedule.

sections.heading: Keep one shift log
paragraphs: At departure, record odometer, state of charge and time. Log each charging stop, waiting time, billed energy and amount paid. At return, record the same starting fields and assignments completed. If the vehicle finishes with more or less charge than it started with, flag that difference before comparing the shift with another vehicle.

sections.heading: Decide what changes before the next batch
paragraphs: Review whether trips finished on time, which charger was actually available, how long the depot needed to turn the vehicle around and who handled issues. Use the pilot results to request changes in charging windows, model mix, training or delivery sequence. Agree success criteria with operations before drawing conclusions from a single unusually easy shift.

checklist: Include a full departure-to-return cycle.
Track waiting time alongside energy use.
Agree the decision criteria before scaling up.

title: All-New VinFast VF 8 Price in the Philippines
description: Compare the official Philippine VF 8 launch prices and prepare a written quotation for your battery arrangement.
summary: VinFast announced Philippine list prices of ₱1,548,000 with battery subscription and ₱1,799,000 with the battery included on 10 November 2026. The difference at purchase is ₱251,000. Request a dated quotation for the exact vehicle and recurring fee before reserving.

sections.heading: Compare the launch figure with your written offer
paragraphs: Check the generation and model year first. Two advertisements carrying the VF 8 name can describe different vehicles, battery arrangements or inclusions. Keep separate lines for the list price, the actual selling price, recurring fees, registration, insurance and delivery. If an advertisement differs from the official announcement, ask the seller to explain the difference in writing.

sections.heading: Will the VF 8 fit the family parking space?
paragraphs: VinFast describes the Philippine model as a five-seat SUV, 4,701 mm long and 1,872 mm wide. Measure the narrowest part of your entrance and the usable length of the space. Allow room to open doors, walk behind the vehicle and reach the charge port. Confirm mirror clearance and the actual approach angle during the viewing.

sections.heading: Arrange a model-specific demonstration
paragraphs: Ask DT Car which VF 8 demonstration vehicle can be arranged in your area. Bring the passengers who use the back seats and the measurements of your usual luggage. Ask to see the charging connection, how to locate a compatible charger on your normal route and how to request after-sales support. Confirm the appointment and written reservation terms before travelling or paying.

checklist: Match generation, model year and battery arrangement.
Itemise the initial and recurring amounts.
Confirm the demonstration vehicle and delivery estimate.

references.label: VinFast Philippines VF 8 launch announcement, 10 November 2026

title: Limo Green vs Herio Green Purchase Prices
description: Compare Limo Green and Herio Green starting prices and prepare a Philippine fleet purchase enquiry.
summary: VinFast’s Philippine list shows Limo Green from ₱1,099,000 with battery subscription or ₱1,399,000 without. Herio Green starts at ₱895,000 or ₱1,045,000 respectively. These are vehicle purchase prices checked on 25 November 2026. Drivers looking for rental terms should use the separate rental enquiry.

sections.heading: Compare the same battery arrangement
paragraphs: On the manufacturer’s list, the purchase-price gap between Limo Green and Herio Green is ₱204,000 with battery subscription. It is ₱354,000 without subscription. If the decision is for several vehicles, compare itemised written quotations for the same fleet size, delivery city and battery arrangement. Ask separately about any recurring charge.

sections.heading: Use a real shift to decide which model to quote
paragraphs: Take a typical passenger manifest and luggage requirement to the viewing. Record how many seats you need with luggage on board, where the vehicle waits between jobs and whether there is enough time to charge before dispatch. For an airport service, use the actual suitcases or their dimensions when checking the load space.

sections.heading: Separate the purchase and rental decisions
paragraphs: A fleet procurement manager can send the model mix, depot and delivery schedule to DT Car for a purchase quotation. A driver comparing rental programmes needs the current payment schedule and contract for a specific unit. Calculate monthly cash outflow using those terms. A vehicle list price alone cannot answer the rental question.

checklist: Compare purchase quotations on identical terms.
Test passenger and luggage fit on the actual model.
Use the rental route for driver contract enquiries.

title: Used Toyota Fortuner G in Manila: Comparing Two Listings
description: Compare two dated Fortuner G advertisements by model year, odometer and asking price before booking a viewing.
summary: On 8 October 2026, DT Car advertised a 2023 Fortuner G at ₱1.28 million with over 60,000 km, and a 2024 Fortuner G at ₱1.38 million with over 20,000 km. These historical asking prices give a buyer two concrete examples to compare. Ask for today’s available unit and quote.

sections.heading: What did the extra ₱100,000 buy on paper?
paragraphs: The newer advertisement paired a later model year with a lower stated odometer reading. Both readings were rounded, so an exact peso-per-kilometre comparison would imply more precision than the listings provide. Neither advertisement establishes a completed sale price.

Start a comparison sheet with a column for each actual unit. Put a question mark beside any unverified detail, including service history, tyre age and the work likely to be due soon. The price difference is much more useful once these questions have answers.

sections.heading: How should I verify which unit I am viewing?
paragraphs: Ask for an updated dashboard photo, the exact variant, the city where it can be inspected and confirmation that the vehicle is still available. Ask to see dated maintenance records. Cross-posts can show the same vehicle in several languages, so compare the actual unit details before counting them as separate options.

sections.heading: Which one should I inspect first?
paragraphs: Inspect the vehicle that meets your passenger, budget and timing needs and has enough records for a meaningful assessment. A higher-mileage SUV with a documented service history and a lower-mileage one with gaps raise different questions. Ask an independent inspector to identify upcoming work on each vehicle before making an offer.

checklist: Record the list date and exact variant.
Check the current odometer and available records.
Ask for written findings on near-term work.

title: Used Mazda CX-5 in Manila: Reading a Price Change
description: See how two dated DT Car asking prices for a 2018 Mazda CX-5 can inform a buyer’s questions.
summary: DT Car’s 19 October 2026 list included a 2018 Mazda CX-5 2.5 AWD Sport at ₱680,000. A 29 October advertisement described the same year, trim and engine at ₱635,000. The advertised difference was ₱45,000. Neither post states a final transaction price.

sections.heading: What can a dated asking price tell me?
paragraphs: The later advertisement described a pearl white automatic SUV with over 50,000 km. Used listings often remain visible after the terms change. Save the date, model year, trim and odometer alongside the price so a screenshot can be traced back to the offer you saw.

The two descriptions are consistent on key details. Without a vehicle identifier, a buyer should still confirm that separate posts refer to the same unit. A November update mentioned a CX-5 sale without publishing a final amount.

sections.heading: Which features should I see on the actual CX-5?
paragraphs: The October advertisement listed a head-up display, sunroof, parking sensors and a premium audio system. If a feature matters to you, ask the seller to show it working during the viewing. Check the condition of the interior and the service record alongside the equipment list.

sections.heading: Can I use ₱635,000 as today’s valuation?
paragraphs: Use the figure as one dated comparable for a particular specification and condition. Obtain current offers on real vehicles, account for immediate repairs identified by inspection and confirm what each quotation includes. Send DT Car your preferred year, variant and budget to ask what is currently available.

checklist: Keep the advertisement date with the price.
Confirm that the photos show the offered unit.
Compare the cost after immediate maintenance.

title: What Does “Reserved” Mean on a Used-Car Listing?
description: Find out what to confirm after a Philippine used-car seller marks a vehicle reserved.
summary: When a car is marked reserved, contact the seller before travelling or sending money. Ask whether a viewing is possible, whether there is a waiting list and when the seller expects to confirm the unit’s status.

sections.heading: A real example from DT Car
paragraphs: On 8 November 2026, Quality Car Manila marked a 2017 BMW 320d and a 2018 Lexus NX reserved. That update showed a change from the earlier advertisements. It did not announce final sale prices or establish that either vehicle would become available again.

sections.heading: What if I already spoke with another agent?
paragraphs: Send the exact listing and ask the team to check the unit before scheduling you. The same vehicle can appear on a company page, a personal profile and a translated page. If two contacts are discussing what appears to be the same unit, ask for one named contact and one written status update.

sections.heading: How do I keep looking without losing the useful details?
paragraphs: Identify what made the car suitable: maximum budget, transmission, passenger needs and the features you actually need. Give that brief to the team and request current alternatives. Before any payment, ask for the specific unit, recipient, reservation conditions and what happens if that unit cannot be supplied.

checklist: Ask who last confirmed the unit status and when.
Keep a copy of the relevant advertisement.
Request comparable available units.

title: How to Refer a Used Car for Sale to DT Car
description: Prepare a seller-authorised vehicle referral and agree on terms before introducing the owner.
summary: Start with the owner’s permission, the vehicle details and the city where it can be inspected. Ask DT Car to confirm the referral process and what qualifies for payment before sharing the owner’s contact details.

sections.heading: What has DT Car reported about referrals?
paragraphs: On 18 November 2026, We Buy Cars reported separate agent introductions involving a 2023 Fortuner G, a 2024 Fortuner G and a Ford Territory. Each post reported a ₱10,000 commission for that particular completed case. The posts describe historical transactions. Obtain the terms for the vehicle you intend to introduce.

sections.heading: What information helps an agent screen a lead?
paragraphs: Ask whether the owner wants a direct offer, help finding a buyer, or an appraisal first. Record the exact variant, model year, mileage, city and the owner’s preferred viewing time. If the vehicle still has a loan, identify that as an item for the owner and lender to discuss. Keep identity and financial documents out of public messages.

sections.heading: How do we avoid duplicate introductions?
paragraphs: Ask the team whether the vehicle is already under discussion and how it records the referral. Confirm the fee, the event that earns it, who will make payment and what happens if another agent introduced the same owner. Keep written confirmation and update the team if the owner withdraws or the vehicle sells elsewhere.

checklist: Get permission for the introduction.
Confirm referral recognition and payment terms.
Provide current vehicle details and viewing availability.

title: Selling a Car With an Outstanding Loan in Manila
description: Prepare a vehicle appraisal and lender settlement enquiry with separate amounts, dates and responsibilities.
summary: Ask the lender for the current settlement amount and instructions. Separately, obtain an offer for the vehicle after inspection. DT Car’s We Buy Cars page advertises assistance discussing bank-loan settlement. The lender must confirm the requirements for the particular account.

sections.heading: Will the sale proceeds cover the balance?
paragraphs: As an illustration, if a written offer is ₱650,000 and the lender quotes ₱580,000 to settle on the agreed date, the difference is ₱70,000 before other confirmed charges. If the settlement amount is higher than the offer, ask how the shortfall would be settled. Request a fresh statement if the payment date moves.

sections.heading: Who receives each payment?
paragraphs: Ask the lender and purchaser to confirm the amounts, authorised recipients, accepted payment channels and sequence in writing. Ask who will obtain the release documents and when the owner will receive the remaining proceeds. Never infer these arrangements from a screenshot of an earlier transaction.

sections.heading: What should I send in the first message?
paragraphs: Provide the model, variant, mileage, city, recent car photos and a note that financing remains outstanding. The appraiser can assess the car while the owner requests a current settlement statement. Share private records only through the agreed channel when the parties actually need them.

checklist: Check the validity date of the lender statement.
Compare the written appraisal and outstanding balance.
Confirm payment and document release arrangements.

title: VinFast MPV 7 Price and Seven-Seat Layout
description: Check Philippine starting prices and usable luggage space for a seven-passenger family trip.
summary: The Philippine price list shows VF MPV 7 from ₱1,239,000 with battery subscription and ₱1,518,000 without, checked 25 November 2026. VinFast lists 126 litres of luggage space with all three rows in use and 607 litres with the third row folded.

sections.heading: Can seven people and their luggage travel together?
paragraphs: The two luggage figures describe different seating arrangements. If you need all seven seats, use the smaller figure as your starting point. Litres alone will not tell you whether a particular suitcase fits through the opening. Bring the dimensions of the bags or stroller you use most often to the viewing.

sections.heading: What if a passenger needs easy access to the third row?
paragraphs: VinFast describes split second-row seats with a fold-and-tumble function. At the appointment, try access with the people who normally travel with you. Check whether the person entering the back row can do so comfortably with your everyday setup in place.

sections.heading: What should go in the quotation?
paragraphs: Ask for the MPV 7 by model name and the battery arrangement you want to compare. Confirm equipment, recurring battery charges where applicable, registration, insurance, delivery and written reservation terms. If you are also considering a Limo Green for commercial use, compare the two exact quotations and seat configurations separately.

checklist: Test the seating layout with your passengers.
Measure luggage with all required seats in use.
Request a dated quote for the exact model.

references.label: VinFast MPV7 seating and luggage information

title: Electric Car Maintenance in the Philippines
description: Plan routine EV maintenance using the model-specific schedule, elapsed time, mileage and workshop records.
summary: Find the service schedule for your exact vehicle and compare it with both the current odometer and the date of the last visit. A low-mileage VinFast can still have time-based checks due. If the record is incomplete, ask the service team to establish what needs attention.

sections.heading: What still needs attention on an electric car?
paragraphs: VinFast’s owner guidance lists tyres, conventional brakes, lights, wipers, cabin filters and the low-voltage battery among items that can require attention. Regenerative braking does not remove the need for conventional brake checks. The applicable service schedule determines the work for your model.

sections.heading: How should I prepare a low-mileage car for service?
paragraphs: Send the vehicle year, model, odometer and last documented service date. Include records from previous workshops if you have them. Ask the adviser to separate items due now, items that need inspection and optional work. This lets you compare the visit with the manufacturer’s maintenance requirements.

sections.heading: What should be recorded after the appointment?
paragraphs: Keep the date, odometer, items inspected or replaced and the next service milestone. Ask who to contact if an alert returns. Leave high-voltage components to qualified technicians. For a new warning or a change in braking, contact your service provider promptly for model-specific instructions.

checklist: Compare elapsed time as well as mileage.
Check the service history against the model’s schedule.
Keep the completed work record and next due date.

title: How to Scope a Fleet Installation Quotation
description: Write a comparable RFQ for SIM-enabled dashcams, meters and stickers across a mixed fleet.
summary: Send suppliers one scope matrix covering vehicle model, equipment, quantity, installation site and acceptance requirement. Price labour and supplied materials separately so each bidder is quoting the same work.

sections.heading: What does one unit of work include?
paragraphs: Consider a depot with two vehicle types. One needs a camera SIM and an activation check. The other also needs stickers and photo evidence. Record them as separate groups and specify who supplies each item. A single average price can hide whether activation, materials or return visits are included.

sections.heading: Which site details affect the quotation?
paragraphs: List vehicle access hours, who controls the keys, how units are staged and whether completed cars can leave immediately. If staff must find each vehicle across a parking area, include that time in the scope. Ask how missing materials or vehicles will be recorded when the installer is already on site.

sections.heading: How can procurement compare the responses?
paragraphs: Request a sample acceptance record, itemised taxes and exclusions, assumptions about quantities and a process for revising the schedule. Compare the total for the same model mix. In the handover meeting, name the person who can sign off each batch and resolve exceptions.

checklist: Separate the tasks by model and equipment.
Identify who supplies materials and manages access.
Use the same acceptance criteria across bids.

title: Preparing a Philippine Property for an EV Site Survey
description: Help the property representative, technical team and leasing contact prepare for the same site visit.
summary: Before arranging a survey, confirm the proposed bays, the authorised property contact and the person who can explain electrical service and site access. Send the map pin and recent photos so the technical team can identify what needs review on arrival.

sections.heading: Who needs to be available during the visit?
paragraphs: The person who approves a lease may not control the parking layout or utility records. Ask the site manager to identify the correct representatives in advance. Agree where the survey team can meet, who can grant access to restricted areas and what photography the property permits.

sections.heading: Which observations can a property owner prepare?
paragraphs: Photograph the proposed area from the road and from inside the parking lot. Note how deliveries, queueing vehicles and customers move at peak times. Record any known flooding and the extent of the affected area. Existing site plans or utility information can help a qualified professional evaluate the proposal. Leave electrical inspection to the authorised technical team.

sections.heading: What should be settled after the visit?
paragraphs: Request a written list of missing information, the contact responsible for each item and the next decision required. Separate the site survey, engineering assessment, internal approval and any commercial agreement when explaining progress to the owner. A survey appointment alone does not establish approval to build.

checklist: Confirm the access, technical and leasing contacts.
Share current parking photos and known site restrictions.
Assign owners to questions raised during the survey.

title: Booking a VinFast Test Drive in Metro Manila
description: Prepare a test drive with an identified model, meeting point and questions about charging, parking and quotations.
summary: Send DT Car your city, preferred VinFast model and two possible appointment times. Ask which demo vehicle is available, where to meet and what to bring. Confirm the specific appointment before travelling.

sections.heading: How do I make the drive relevant to my route?
paragraphs: Bring the dimensions of your parking space and note the tightest turning or reversing manoeuvre you regularly make. Ask whether the appointment can include a safe parking demonstration. If the main concern is family access, arrange time to try the rear seats while the car is parked.

sections.heading: Which questions belong in the charging demonstration?
paragraphs: Ask to see the inlet on the exact model, compatible equipment, how the driver starts and ends a session and where to find the current charging terms. Identify a primary and a backup location near your normal route. Record any compatibility question that the adviser needs to confirm in writing.

sections.heading: What should I leave with?
paragraphs: Record the model and variant driven, what you could verify and what remains unknown. Ask for a current quotation, battery arrangement, availability and proposed handover window. If a different trim was demonstrated, identify which equipment changes on the vehicle being quoted. Confirm the reservation conditions separately.

checklist: Confirm the demo unit and appointment location.
Bring parking and load requirements.
Ask for a written quotation for the exact trim.

title: Paano mag-apply bilang Green GSM taxi driver sa Pilipinas
description: Alamin ang kailangan sa lisensya, paano magtanong sa recruitment team, at ano ang dapat kumpirmahin bago pumunta sa depot para sa interview at driving test.
summary: Kung gusto mong magmaneho ng Green GSM taxi, puwede kang magsimula sa opisyal na online application o magtanong sa DT Car tungkol sa recruitment. Ayon sa Green GSM, kailangang 18 taong gulang pataas at may valid na Philippine professional driver’s license. Kumpirmahin ang depot at iskedyul bago bumiyahe.

sections.heading: Ano ang kailangan sa aplikante?
paragraphs: Tingnan ang expiry date at uri ng lisensya mo. Kung student permit o non-professional ang hawak mo, ang nakalistang requirement ng Green GSM para sa taxi driver ay professional license. Kung malapit na itong mag-expire, tanungin ang recruitment team kung kailan kailangang magpakita ng updated na lisensya.

Maghanda ng maikling paglalarawan ng karanasan mo. Halimbawa, sabihin kung anong sasakyan ang minaneho mo, gaano katagal, at aling mga ruta ang pamilyar sa iyo. Binabanggit ng Green GSM ang kaalaman sa ruta at maayos na pakikitungo sa pasahero.

sections.heading: Ano ang puwedeng i-message sa DT Car?
paragraphs: Puwede mong kopyahin ito at palitan ang nasa bracket. “Magandang araw po. Gusto kong mag-apply bilang Green GSM taxi driver. Taga-[lungsod] ako at may valid na professional license. May [tagal] akong karanasan sa pagmamaneho. Available ako sa [araw]. Saang depot po ang interview at ano ang kailangan kong dalhin?”

Sa unang tanong, sapat nang sabihin kung valid ang lisensya. Kapag hiningi na ang kopya, kumpirmahin kung aling opisyal na application channel ang tatanggap nito. Iwasang ilagay ang numero o litrato ng lisensya sa pampublikong comment.

sections.heading: Ano ang dapat kumpirmahin bago ang interview?
paragraphs: Humingi ng eksaktong address, landmark o entrance, oras ng pagdating, at listahan ng dokumento para sa schedule mo. May in-person interview at driving test sa prosesong inilathala ng Green GSM. Kung manggagaling ka sa malayo, itanong kung parehong gagawin ang dalawang hakbang sa araw ng appointment.
Kung may nakita kang post tungkol sa kita o incentive, itanong kung paano ito kinukuwenta para sa shift at lugar na inaalok sa iyo. Hingin ang detalye ng offer bago magdesisyon.

sections.heading: Paano mag-follow up pagkatapos mag-apply?
paragraphs: Gamitin ang parehong recruitment conversation. Sabihin kung kailan ka nag-apply o na-interview, aling depot ang nakausap mo, at kung ano ang huling instruction. Itanong kung may kulang na dokumento at kung kailan ang susunod na update. Ang Green GSM ang nagkukumpirma ng assessment at onboarding.
Kung ang balak mo ay umupa ng EV para sa sariling pasada, piliin ang hiwalay na gabay sa rental sa ibaba. Para sa aplikanteng naghahanap ng trabaho bilang taxi driver, gamitin ang recruitment link.

checklist: Tingnan kung valid ang professional license.
Ihanda ang lungsod, karanasan at available na araw.
Kumpirmahin ang depot, oras at kailangang dokumento.
Itabi ang confirmation at susunod na instruction.
